F01-F06 are known failures; F13 is separately blocked, not a waiver. Correctly omit paid software, historical OOB->NVOS and the contradicted RMS->NVSwitch-BMC API claim.

arrow_traceability.reason: All 14 visible arrowheads and stems are recoverably traceable; the bridge is not a fake connection and labels have clear owners. Nonetheless v1 literally has two adjacent taps instead of the explicitly requested one split point (F01), and the v3 long gRPC route has an avoidable lower dogleg caused by its crossed source-port assignment (F07). The clean diagnostic and attempt budget do not waive source-named bus semantics or route economy.

layout_fit.reason: All graph geometry and labels fit natural 77x47 in final-spec pinned dumps; measured live panes are separately 83x51. However v3 has an avoidable bridge due to crossed source-port ordering (F07); lost source facts also prevent complete split-view coverage. Two target UI quit hints truncate, a recorded minor observation, not the basis for this category decision.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: 83x51 ANSI directly shows source-backed related hue families and target text confirms their nearby geometry: management blue, OOB plant teal, hardware orange, NVSwitch software pink; in-band cluster pink and compute-host software teal. NVOS (tray), DCGM (host), management labels and NVOS hosts NMX carry residency anchors. No geometric-depth grouping is asserted. Missing group blocks/titles contradict the skill promise but are not a pass condition in this fixed category; no per-node cross-view hue gate is added. Target capture incompleteness is not silently approved: it blocks border evidence and is a workflow gap.

findings.description: [Defect; renderer-level] The explicit one-spot OOB split is not drawn. At target (56,24) the bus has a downward tap (┬); at adjacent (57,24) it has an upward tap (┴). This is one connected bus and three correct destinations, but two distinct attachment points, not the demanded single split. The compact fork preserves connectivity, not the exact one-split meaning. A clean check, poorer alternatives, or exhausted budget cannot waive this human constraint.

[Defect; skill/spec-level] The shelf API label is exactly Redfish shelf. Redfish is retained, but the source table explicitly says Redfish/HTTPS for this hop. No visible key transfers HTTPS from the separate Compute BMC edge. A private abbreviation expansion in generation.json is not full rendered protocol coverage.

[Defect; skill/spec-level] RMS-to-NVOS control retains NVUE REST but drops the independently stated SSH/SFTP mechanisms from every final view. Same endpoints do not make those protocol facts duplicates. The source correction does not retract them; recorded deliberate omission is not preservation.

[Defect; skill/spec-level] Compute BMC is a readable device-class node, but the source fact that a GB300 NVL72 has 18 compute-tray BMCs is missing from all visible views/keys. Removing x18 to reduce extent loses an identifier/count; the later three-class bus request does not change that multiplicity.

[Defect; skill/spec-level] CDU-controller and PDU OOB reach are stated source facts but have no visible cross-view or qualified companion coverage. Keeping exactly three destination classes on the requested main bus is correct; treating that composition request as permission to erase the other source-backed reach facts everywhere is not. They need not be added as a fourth/fifth main-bus branch to be preserved.

[Defect; skill/spec-level] The edge from DCGM to dcgm-exporter is labelled serves :9400. The excerpts assign the :9400 Prometheus serving role to dcgm-exporter, not to DCGM serving the exporter. The port and historical direction survive, but the visible action does not establish the source-backed server ownership; this is not independent validation of the old unlabeled chain.

[Defect; renderer-level] The single v3 bridge at (40,21) is distinguishable, but avoidable: the NVOS-bound route uses the right source port at x42 and passes left across the NMX-bound route leaving x40. Reversing that source-port order can preserve all three node tiers and endpoints without this crossing; the NMX target already has a port at x42. The long route also adds a two-column bottom dogleg. The lr probe having one bridge is not proof that one is obstacle-forced.

[Evidence gap] All 17 occurrences and 498 perimeter cells have complete, uniform normal/selected borders in 83x51 ANSI, but target 77x47 normal ANSI and select-all ANSI/buffer evidence are absent for all four views. Target plain text proves geometry and no border/palette collision, not color/selection. Target border-integrity approval is blocked, not passed.

[Evidence gap] Target captures contain three timestamped static text frames per final view, but there is no corresponding target ANSI or target selected-state capture. Original live panes are honestly measured at 83x51, not 77x47. The frozen metadata accepts pinned text dumps for fit; it does not turn them into color/selection evidence. All-four-view target capture coverage is incomplete.

[Defect] attempts.json declares v2 attempt 3 SHA-256 fa5c790f1c76f9a8dd390ce1df7482652c0142f3614cc60285952408cabffc42, but the preserved attempt/final spec hashes to fa5c790f1c76f9a8dd390ce1ed7482652c0142f3614cc60285952408cabffc42. Final generation/capture hashes are correct, so this is a localized reproducibility-ledger error, not an unidentified final spec. This is document evidence, with no honest canvas coordinate.

[Defect] The generator says duplicate Redfish/HTTPS labels in rejected v2 attempts motivated the Redfish shelf abbreviation. Both preserved rejected specs already use Redfish shelf and include a third dashed BMC path edge. Thus those raw records do not substantiate the claimed duplicate-label experiment or the abbreviation remedy. Removing the contradicted NVSwitch-BMC edge is source-correct, but not proof that weakening another label was necessary.

[Evidence gap] Attempt check stdout is present, and final check_exit=0 appears in manifests. Rejected-attempt records do not preserve per-invocation exit status/full stderr/expanded commands, and the trunk-permutation table is a summary rather than full raw output for every probe. Five extra pane closures are named only in generator narrative, without a verbatim close/probe result. Do not infer successful statuses or proven cleanup from their absence.

[Source/capability blocker, not a proven false dependency] The dashed Driver+CUDA -> Fabric Mgr arrow is explicitly unconfirmed, as the blind record observed. This correctly avoids inventing deploys/manages, but the authorized source does not establish the relationship. Keep this required historical-claim audit blocked rather than declaring a source-verified edge. No amount of additional viewer evidence would verify the missing interface fact.

blockers: Evidence gap: all four 77x47 target views lack normal ANSI/buffer and select-all color evidence; 83x51 captures cannot establish target selected-state behavior.
Source blocker: Driver+CUDA -> Fabric Mgr has no supported interface semantics in the authorized excerpts; dashed unconfirmed is honest, not a source-verified pass.

Capability limitation: the frozen renderer fell back to two adjacent OOB taps; the supplied one-junction alternatives have bridges/shared runs. No supplied executed evidence demonstrates the required single split with clean traceability. Search-budget exhaustion is not proof of mathematical infeasibility.
Evidence gap: rejected/probe raw command/exit/stderr records are incomplete, and five extra reported pane closures lack preserved verbatim close results.
